case_name: Sangeeta Menon W/O Sri. Anil Menon vs Anil Menon S/O K.G.K. Menon
facts_of_case: Petitioner seeks to set aside order dated 14.12.09 passed by Family Court, Bangalore, in M.C. No.2068/2007. Petitioner claims monthly maintenance and litigation expenses from respondent.

legal_principles.principle: A wife's earning capacity is not sufficient to maintain herself and her child if she has no other source of income.
legal_principles.held: The Court below has recorded a finding that the wife has been earning almost a sum of Rs.12,000/- per month, but it was no need for a direction to the respondent to maintain his wife and child as the amount earned by the wife is sufficient to maintain herself and to take care of her child.

legal_principles.principle: A court may not order interim maintenance if the wife has sufficient earning capacity to maintain herself and her child.
legal_principles.held: The Court below has proceeded to hold that the application for interim maintenance was left with no source of income, but it is held that the wife's earning capacity is sufficient to maintain herself and to take care of her child.

outcome.final_order: Court directed respondent to pay a sum of Rs.25,000/- towards monthly maintenance and Rs.15,000/- towards litigation expenses.
